summary: Premium romantic single-page proposal website for Mann to ask Urvi Ji to be his Valentine/life partner, featuring animated romantic visuals, music, story timeline, gallery, and interactive proposal CTA.
architectural_notes: Single-page responsive proposal site with emphasis on performance (fast loading) despite animation effects.
Include a background music toggle (user-controlled audio).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Seamless romantic background pattern with subtle hearts and sparkles (romantic-bg-pattern.dim_2048x2048.png)
- Rose petal particle sprite sheet, soft semi-transparent petals (rose-petals-sprite.dim_512x512.png)
- Heart particle sprite sheet, soft semi-transparent hearts (hearts-sprite.dim_512x512.png)
- Gold-accent favicon with heart motif (favicon-heart-gold.dim_256x256.png)

existing_features.title: Create a single-page website with a premium, dreamy romantic visual theme using blush pink, red, white, and gold accents; include soft glow, gentle gradients, and consistent typography (elegant serif for headings + handwritten-style font for personal messages).

Implement the Hero section with the exact heading text "Hey Urvi Ji ❤️" and sub-text "From the moment you came into my life, everything became more beautiful." Add a visible heart-beat animation on/near the hero heart and subtle entrance animation on load.

Add ambient romantic background effects across the page: (1) floating hearts and (2) gently falling rose petals with soft blur/glow; ensure the effects are performant and can be reduced/disabled based on user preference (e.g., a UI toggle or respecting reduced motion).

Add gentle romantic instrumental background music with a clear music toggle (play/pause + volume or mute). Follow browser autoplay policies by starting muted or only starting playback after explicit user interaction; persist the user’s choice for the session.

Create a Love Story section as a timeline or card-style layout containing the three requested beats: “How we met”, “Why she is special”, and “How she calls me ‘good boy’ and how that makes me feel loved”. Provide well-written English copy placeholders for each card/timeline node (editable in code).

Implement a Photo Gallery section with a soft animated photo slider/carousel using the two uploaded images (Snapchat-869212999.jpg, Snapchat-261174748.jpg) as initial slides; style it with rounded corners, subtle shadows, and cinematic transitions. Include an “Add photos” UX that lets the user add more images client-side for the current session (no backend persistence required).

Add a “Message From Me” section that displays the exact handwritten-style text: “I may not be perfect, but my love for you is pure and forever.” Include subtle paper/ink styling while keeping readability high.

Create the Proposal section as the main highlight with large glowing text: “Urvi Ji, will you be my Valentine? 💍❤️” and two animated buttons labeled exactly “💖 YES” and “😜 Of course YES”. On click of either button, trigger a celebratory “heart explodes with love” animation and show a sweet pop-up/modal message: “You just made me the happiest person alive 💕”.
Add a Footer with the exact text “Made with endless love by Mann” (use Mann from the provided name).

Implement smooth scrolling navigation behavior for a single-page flow (e.g., subtle scroll snapping or a small section nav) and ensure the entire page is mobile responsive and fast-loading (optimize assets, avoid heavy libraries). Provide a clear way to share the link (e.g., a “Copy link” button that copies window.location.href).
